title: Create finding registry and remediation plan
description:
Create `docs/audits/remediation-plan.md` after the current-state audit and before any production edit. Convert confirmed findings into a decision-complete delivery sequence rather than a generic backlog.

The plan must contain the baseline and architecture summary, prioritized finding table, dependency graph, expected files, regression tests, persistence and SecretStorage migrations, security constraints, rollback procedures, explicit non-goals, and definition of done. Assign work to Batch 0 through Batch 5 by actual severity and prerequisite order. If the formal audit finds no Blocker/Critical issue, say so rather than promoting lower-risk defects.

Each finding must have one owner task, a smallest coherent fix, a required regression test, and a clear completion signal. The document is also the execution ledger: update batch status and deviations after every implementation batch.

checklist.text: Build the prioritized finding table from the completed audit with stable IDs and justified severities
Map prerequisite and related-finding dependencies so batches can be executed safely
Assign every finding to Batch 0-5 with expected files, effort, and regression tests
Specify persistence migrations, SecretStorage behavior, backups, rollback, and compatibility guarantees
Document security considerations, non-goals, deferred capability gaps, and stopping conditions
Define targeted and full-suite validation required for every batch
Confirm the remediation plan exists and is internally consistent before production changes begin
